# Dr Ramesh Aravind — Official Website

> Official website of Dr Ramesh Aravind: Indian actor of 140+ films since 1986, film director, television host of Weekend With Ramesh, author and motivational speaker based in Bengaluru.

Dr Ramesh Aravind is an Indian actor, film director, screenwriter, television host, author and motivational speaker. He has acted in more than 140 films in Kannada, Tamil, Telugu and Hindi since 1986, directed eight feature films, and hosted five seasons of Weekend With Ramesh on Zee Kannada.

## Quick facts

- **Name**: Dr Ramesh Aravind (Kannada: ರಮೇಶ್ ಅರವಿಂದ್)
- **Born**: 10 September 1964, Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Based in**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Occupations**: Actor, director, screenwriter, television host, author, motivational speaker, producer
- **Active since**: 1986
- **Languages**: Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, English
- **Honorary doctorate**: Rani Channamma University, Belagavi (2022)
- **Contact for bookings**: enquiry@ramesharavind.com

## Career as an actor

He made his debut in the Kannada film Sundara Swapnagalu (1986), followed by his Tamil debut Manathil Uruthi Vendum (1987) and his Telugu debut Rudraveena (1988). Notable films:

- Sundara Swapnagalu (1986, Kannada) — debut
- America America (Kannada) — Karnataka State Film Award for Best Actor, 1996–97
- Amrutha Varshini (1997, Kannada) — Filmfare Award South, Best Actor – Kannada
- O Mallige (1997, Kannada) — Udaya Film Award, Best Actor
- Hoomale (1998, Kannada) — Filmfare Award South, Best Actor – Kannada
- Panchatanthiram (2002, Tamil)
- Pushpaka Vimana (2017, Kannada)
- Shivaji Surathkal (2020, Kannada)
- Shivaji Surathkal 2 (2023, Kannada) — Chandanavana Film Critics Academy Award, Best Actor
- Bhairadevi (2024, Kannada)

## Career as a director

- Rama Shama Bhama (2005, Kannada) — Udaya Film Award, Best Debut Director (2006)
- Sathyavan Savithri (2007, Kannada)
- Accident (2008, Kannada)
- Venkata in Sankata (2009, Kannada)
- Nammanna Don (2012, Kannada)
- Uttama Villain (2015, Tamil) — starring Kamal Haasan
- Sundaranga Jaana (2016, Kannada)
- 100 (2021, Kannada)

## Television

- Weekend With Ramesh — host, Zee Kannada, five seasons
- Kannadada Kotyadhipati — host, Season 3 (Kannada version of Who Wants to Be a Millionaire)
- Mahanati — judge, Zee Kannada, 2024
- Raja Rani, Preetiyinda Ramesh — host
- Parichaya — host, DD Kannada

As a producer: Supernatural Fiction (Udaya TV, 2019–2020), Sundari (Udaya TV, 2021–2023), Neenadena (Star Suvarna, 2023–present) and Aase (Star Suvarna, 2023–present).

## Books

1. **Preetiyinda Ramesh** (Kannada) — bestseller; five editions in five months
2. **Art of Success** (Kannada) — collection of his quotes on success
3. **It's No Fun Without U** (English) — inspirational stories and life lessons
4. **Anbudan Ramesh** (Tamil, 2024) — Tamil edition of Preetiyinda Ramesh

Audiobook: MasadaMaatu with Ramesh (Kannada, Storytel), written and narrated by him.

## Awards and honours

- Karnataka State Film Award — Best Actor (America America, 1996–97)
- Filmfare Award South — Best Actor – Kannada (Amrutha Varshini, 1997)
- Udaya Film Award — Best Actor (O Mallige, 1997)
- Screen Award — Best Actor – Kannada (1997)
- Filmfare Award South — Best Actor – Kannada (Hoomale, 1998)
- Udaya Film Award — Best Debut Director (Rama Shama Bhama, 2006)
- Suvarna Film Award — Best Actor in a comedy role (Rama Shama Bhama, 2006)
- Chandanavana Film Critics Academy Award — Best Actor (Shivaji Surathkal 2, 2024)
- Pride of Zee Kannada, Zee Kutumba Awards (2015)
- Nadaprabhu Kempegowda Award (2018)
- Honorary doctorate, Rani Channamma University (2022)

## Motivational speaking

He speaks in English, Kannada and Tamil at corporate events, educational institutions and conferences on personal growth, leadership, success mindset, overcoming failure, cultural pride and storytelling. Bookings: enquiry@ramesharavind.com

## Brand associations

TMT Steel, Siri beverages, Aashirvaad's Chilli, Narayanashastra, Vasu Agarbathies, Silk Shirts and Dhoti; CMCA brand ambassador.
